result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example hasn't been run as a test.

In `DataStore.java` I added a new `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant to the `CustomerAttributedRecords` enum. It matches `PURCHASE_ORDERS` but adds `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` now uses it, and I updated its Javadoc. I didn't touch the existing query, so reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, highest count first.

The per-country purchase-order report uses the same `PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant, so I left it alone and it still counts cancelled orders. If you want it to match, change it to use `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS`.
